screen.justenoughbackups.config.backup_m:
FULL: copies the whole world every time. Safest and easiest to restore.
PARTIAL: copies only files changed since the latest backup. Smaller, but depends on the backup chain.
DIFFERENTIAL: copies files changed since the latest full backup. Larger than partial, simpler to restore.
screen.justenoughbackups.config.automati: When enabled, the server creates backups automatically at the configured interval.
screen.justenoughbackups.config.pause_wi: Skips scheduled automatic backups if no player has been online since the last backup.
screen.justenoughbackups.config.backup_o: Creates one backup when the server finishes starting the world. Disabled by default.
Creates one backup while the server is shutting down. Shutdown waits for it to finish. Disabled by default.
screen.justenoughbackups.config.interval: Minutes between automatic backups. The timer resets when this value is saved.
screen.justenoughbackups.config.automati: Enable or customize time intervals for automatic backups.
When enabled, full backups run automatically at the configured interval.
When enabled, differential backups run automatically at the configured interval.
When enabled, partial backups run automatically at the configured interval.
Minutes between automatic full backups. Only applies if automatic full backups are enabled.
Minutes between automatic differential backups. Only applies if automatic differential backups are enabled.
Minutes between automatic partial backups. Only applies if automatic partial backups are enabled.
Sends one public warning before an automatic backup starts. Uses the configured message channel.
How many minutes before an automatic backup the warning should be sent.
screen.justenoughbackups.config.backup_d: Directory where backups are stored. Relative paths are resolved from the game directory.
screen.justenoughbackups.config.temp_dir:
Directory where the backup ZIP is compressed before being moved into the backup directory.
Relative paths are resolved from the game directory.
Leave empty to use the backup directory.
screen.justenoughbackups.config.permissi:
Minimum Minecraft permission level required to use /jeb.
0: anyone can use it.
1: low-level permissions.
2: operators/gamemasters. Default.
3: admins.
4: server owners/highest permission level.
screen.justenoughbackups.config.message_:
Controls public server backup and restore announcements.
CHAT: sends regular chat messages.
ACTION_BAR: sends action bar messages. Default.
OFF: disables public announcements.
screen.justenoughbackups.config.integrit:
STRICT: failed backups are discarded and damaged restores are blocked.
PERMISSIVE: partial backups may remain, but damaged restores are blocked.
VERY_PERMISSIVE: damaged restores can continue with a warning. Use only for manual recovery.
screen.justenoughbackups.config.include_:
Adds a summary.txt file to each backup ZIP with world details, versions, and the loaded mod list. 
Restoring that backup will also restore the summary file into the world.
screen.justenoughbackups.config.keep_ful: Maximum number of full backups to keep. At least one full backup is always retained.
screen.justenoughbackups.config.keep_par: Maximum number of partial backups to keep. Required base backups are protected.
screen.justenoughbackups.config.keep_dif: Maximum number of differential backups to keep. Required full backups are protected.
screen.justenoughbackups.config.max_tota:
Maximum total size in MB for this world's backup folder. 0 disables the size limit. 
Count-based retention and dependency protection still apply.
screen.justenoughbackups.config.minimum_:
Extra disk space in MB that must remain free before a backup starts. 
The pre-check requires world size x2 plus this reserve.
screen.justenoughbackups.config.thread_c:
Number of parallel threads used for file hashing, ZIP extraction, and restore operations.
Higher values speed up large worlds but increase CPU usage. Defaults to CPU cores minus two.
screen.justenoughbackups.config.excluded: Files or folders to skip during backup. Use world-relative paths and manage them with the + and - buttons.
screen.justenoughbackups.config.show_pop: Shows the backup progress HUD on clients with the mod installed.
screen.justenoughbackups.config.show_tit: Shows or hides the title line at the top of the backup popup.
screen.justenoughbackups.config.center_t: Centers the popup title, status text, and progress line inside the popup.
screen.justenoughbackups.config.show_bor: Draws a thin popup border using the text color.
screen.justenoughbackups.config.preview_: Selects the sample state used by the popup preview editor.
screen.justenoughbackups.config.popup_ti: Title shown at the top of the backup popup.
screen.justenoughbackups.config.running_: Status text color used while a backup is running.

screen.justenoughbackups.config.failed_c: Status text color used when a backup fails.
screen.justenoughbackups.config.text_col: Text color used for the title and progress line.
